steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow a vendor to be added during event creation.
Provide the required event title.
Create the required Technical + RFQ stage combination.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor to the event.
Publish the configured event.
Verify that the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the technical stage first to verify RFQ-only terms are not shown there.
Assert that the RFQ clause is absent from the technical-stage response.
Assert that the second RFQ clause is also absent from the technical-stage response.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the mandatory clauses should be presented.
Verify the first RFQ clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second RFQ clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Try to submit the quote after only one mandatory clause was accepted; submission should be blocked.
